endorsements.quote: Are you planning for pilot/silent tests?
Have you prepared necessary training/resources for end users?
Have you secured any required regulatory approval?
Are you providing user tools for continuous validation and evaluation of the system?
Have you involved and tested with users?
Have you accounted for and evaluated existing clinical workflows?

unlisted_practices: Plan for data drift and shift (changes in the data over time) in AI systems.
Plan for continuous user feedback on the AI system.
Engage domain experts in data preparation, cleaning, and engineering.
Outline expected impacts on patient outcomes and care provider efficiency before AI development.
Conduct an economic analysis of the AI system.
Identify key stakeholders and their needs and organizational barriers to AI adoption.
Take active steps to mitigate biased results in AI models.
Ensure AI alerts are relevant, timely, and not overwhelming to avoid alert fatigue.
Plan for continuous education and support for AI users.
Create a plan to evaluate the success of AI implementation.
Ensure AI interventions align with the organization's existing governance and regulatory frameworks.

screen.reason: This is an instrument development / Delphi consensus study creating a checklist and framework for implementing clinical AI, which constitutes guidance/recommendations rather than an empirical evaluation of an AI system.
